title: Cell Membrane and Materials Movement Review Test
description: Spaced review for model how cell membranes help cells exchange materials while maintaining workable internal conditions.

questions.prompt: What is one main role of the cell membrane?
questions.questionText: What is one main role of the cell membrane?
options: to help control what moves into and out of a cell
questions.correctAnswer: to help control what moves into and out of a cell
questions.explanation: The membrane is a selective boundary.

options: cell color -> favorite food -> no data
outside condition -> concentration difference -> membrane movement -> cell effect
questions.correctAnswer: outside condition -> concentration difference -> membrane movement -> cell effect
questions.explanation: The chain connects cause and cell effect.

questions.prompt: A student says the membrane blocks all materials. What is the best correction?
questions.questionText: A student says the membrane blocks all materials. What is the best correction?
options: Cells exchange materials through controlled movement across the membrane.
questions.correctAnswer: Cells exchange materials through controlled movement across the membrane.
questions.explanation: Cells must take in and release materials.

questions.prompt: Why should the cucumber slices be the same size?
questions.questionText: Why should the cucumber slices be the same size?
options: to control variables so the water movement comparison is fair
questions.correctAnswer: to control variables so the water movement comparison is fair
questions.explanation: Fair tests change one main variable.

options: How would the result change if the outside solution were less salty?
How long is the word membrane?
questions.correctAnswer: How would the result change if the outside solution were less salty?
questions.explanation: Changing the condition tests the model.

options: color stays only in the label
color is darkest near the drop at first, then spreads outward over time
questions.correctAnswer: color is darkest near the drop at first, then spreads outward over time
questions.explanation: Spreading over time is a diffusion pattern.

options: More trials would strengthen the claim.
This one cucumber test proves every membrane moves every material the same way.
The salty condition may cause water loss.
questions.correctAnswer: This one cucumber test proves every membrane moves every material the same way.
questions.explanation: One test should not be overgeneralized.

questions.prompt: What should a graph of potato mass in salty water show if water leaves cells?
questions.questionText: What should a graph of potato mass in salty water show if water leaves cells?
options: mass increases because labels are bigger

questions.prompt: Which result would weaken the salt-water claim?
questions.questionText: Which result would weaken the salt-water claim?
options: all slices changed the same way, including the no-salt control
repeated trials showed similar water loss
the salty slice became more flexible
questions.correctAnswer: all slices changed the same way, including the no-salt control
questions.explanation: If the control changes the same way, salt may not be the cause.

options: The plate pulled out the water with feelings.
The salt outside created a concentration difference that led to water movement out of cells.
questions.correctAnswer: The salt outside created a concentration difference that led to water movement out of cells.

questions.prompt: Which evidence combines model and data?
questions.questionText: Which evidence combines model and data?
options: a sketch with no labels and no measurements
a diagram of water leaving cells plus measured mass loss
questions.correctAnswer: a diagram of water leaving cells plus measured mass loss
questions.explanation: Models and measurements support each other.

questions.prompt: Why is the membrane not the same as a wall around a room?
questions.questionText: Why is the membrane not the same as a wall around a room?
options: it is made of desk wood
it is a living boundary involved in selective material exchange
it has no relationship to cells
questions.correctAnswer: it is a living boundary involved in selective material exchange

questions.prompt: What would be the best next investigation?
questions.questionText: What would be the best next investigation?
options: compare several salt concentrations while keeping sample size and time constant
questions.correctAnswer: compare several salt concentrations while keeping sample size and time constant
questions.explanation: A range of concentrations tests the model.

questions.prompt: Which strategy helps remember the concept?
questions.questionText: Which strategy helps remember the concept?
options: say the memory anchor, then explain one evidence example
